sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
Though this appeal is listed for admission, with the consent of both counsel, it is taken up for final disposal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to by their rank before the Tribunal.

3. Heard learned counsel for the appellants and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent.
4.
Learned counsel for the appellants has submitted her argument that the appellants have lost their valuable lands which was only source for the livelihood to them and their family.
Now they have lost the said lands for the public purpose which was water resourced through the year.

When the respondent snatched the valuable lands they should pay the just compensation by fixing the actual market value on par with the Cross Objection No.114/2006 and Crob No.115/2006, Cross Obj.No.241/2007 Cross Obj. No.236/2007 and other connected matters in MFA No.2028/2005,
MFA No.2020/2005, MFA No.2031/2005, MFA No.2019/2005 and other connected matters.
Therefore, the order passed by the reference court is liable to be modified by enhancing the compensation.

To substantiate her arguments, she relied on judgment passed in MFA No.31868/2012(LAC) dated 06.04.2021.
5.
Learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent not disputed the judgment passed in MFA No.31868/2012.

Further, she has submitted that SLAO has not preferred any appeal against the MFA No.31868/2012 dated 06.04.2021.
6.

Having heard both parties, the following points would arise for consideration:
1) Whether the appellant is entitled for enhancement of compensation to the extent of Rs.1,60,000/- per acre as per the judgment passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.31868/2012 dated 06.04.2021?

sentences.text: What order/award?

7. My findings to the above points are as under:
Point No.1 : In Affirmative Point No.2 : As per final order:
8.
The appellants have preferred this appeal against common judgment and award passed in LAC Nos.192, 193, 194 & 184 of 2000 on the file of II-Addl.
Civil Judge
(Sr.Dn.) Bijapur.
The reference Court has awarded compensation of Rs.82,000/- per acre.
The claimant in LAC No.194/2000 had preferred MFA No.31868/2012.

The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has disposed of MFA No.31868/2012 vide order dated 06.04.2021 and this Court has enhanced compensation awarded by the reference Court from Rs.1,09,800/- for dry lands and Rs.1,60,000/- for wet lands.
9. The impugned judgment and award reveals that land in question is also irrigated lands.

The judgment passed in MFA No.31868/2012 is arising of common judgment passed in LAC Nos.192,
193, 194 & 184 of 2000.
The Co-ordinate Bench has followed the judgment passed in MFA Nos.2028/2005, 2020/2005 and 2031/2005 and other connected matters.
10. Considering the judgment passed in MFA No.31868/2012 (LAC) dated 06.04.2021, it is just and proper to award compensation to the land in question.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
(i) The appeal is partly allowed.

(ii) The compensation awarded by the reference Court is enhanced to Rs.1,60,000/-
per acre as against Rs.82,000/- per acre.

(iii) The appellants are entitled to all statutory benefits under Sections 23(1-A), 23(2)
and Section 28 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
(iv) The appellants are not entitled to any interest on the enhanced compensation for the delayed period (i.e. delay of 2319 days in filing the recalling application and delay of 3111 days in filing the appeal).
 (v) Draw award accordingly.
 Sd/-
 JUDGE SDU Kallappa S/O Girivappa Mannur vs The Assistant Commissioner on 12 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14385121/
